_baselineNote: CNX's default forecast anchors 2026/2027/2028 total production to its guided FY2026 total (605-620 Bcfe, mid 612.5, reaffirmed), held flat forward since CNX did not guide 2027/2028 production. The gas/NGL/oil split derives from CNX's guided FY2026 liquids-mix percentage (7-8%, mid 7.5%) applied to the guided total, then split between NGL and oil using CNX's own Q2 2026 reported NGL:oil ratio (oil is a de minimis ~2.6% of liquids, <0.1% of total production). CNX guides only a single blended cash-unit-cost figure (fully_burdened_cash_cost, $1.15/Mcfe); LOE, gathering/transport, and cash G&A are each proportionally scaled from the Q2 2026 reported mix to reconcile with that guided total. CNX guides an absolute FY2026 NGL price ($24.60/bbl, used directly) and its own NYMEX gas-price planning assumption ($3.55/MMBtu, used as the default Henry Hub input when no live/custom price is supplied -- preferred over the Q2 2026 realized benchmark ($2.89) because it is management's current forward view, the same precedence the RRC reference model applies). UPDATED (financial-integrity review, post-initial-build): Adjusted EBITDAX now includes a $90mm/yr non-commodity addback for CNX's guided environmental-attribute monetization -- verified against CNX's Q2 2026 Form 10-Q, which recognizes environmental-attribute sales within 'Other Revenue and Operating Income,' a component of CNX's own GAAP-based Adjusted EBITDAX that this engine's commodity-only revenue calculation would otherwise omit every forecast year. FCF is tax-effected on the same addback at each year's resolved cash tax rate. CNX's separately guided 45Z tax-credit monetization (~$40mm/yr) was deliberately NOT added: per the Q2 2026 10-Q's income-tax footnote, that credit is recorded through the income-tax provision, not revenue/operating income, and is excluded from EBITDAX by definition (EBITDAX excludes taxes). Default-forecast EBITDAX ($1,269.8mm) now runs ~1.6% below CNX's own guided FY2026 EBITDAX ($1,290mm), down from an ~8.5% gap before this addback. Net debt declines dollar-for-dollar with cumulative forecast FCF only (no dividends/buybacks/financing modeled).
